entries.german: (in die sollempnitatis coronationis nostre) nimmt in einer umfassenden urkunde die stadt Achen in seinen schutz und bestätigt ihre privilegien. Z.: Baldewin erzbischof v. Trier, reichserzkanzler in Gallien, Engelbert bischof v. Lüttich; Rudolf und Ruprecht Rheinpfalzgrafen, die herzoge Johann v. Brabant, Heinrich sein sohn, Heinrich v. Glogau, Wladislaus v. Teschen, Wilhelm markgraf v. Jülich; die äbte Richard v. St. Cornelis-Inden, und Hugo v. Stablo; die grafen Johann v. Spanheim, Wilhelm v. Wied und Wilhelm v. Katzenellenbogen; die edeln Johann herr v. Falkenberg, Johann v. Falkenberg herr von Burn, Reinold v. Randinrode, Jodok v. Rosenberg, Bernhard v. Czimburg sein hofmeister, Sbinco v. Hasenburg und Busco v. Wilhartitz, seine kammermeister, Arnold v. Bolant und Heinrich v. Huffalitz. Ego Nicol. aule regie cancell. prepos. Prag. vice et nom. Baldwini aepi Trevir. s. imp. per Galliam archicanc. rec. Quix Aachen 2,240‒244. Loersch Achener Rechtsdenkmäler 58‒66.
entries.english: (on the solemnity of our coronation) by a comprehensive charter places the city of Aachen under his protection and confirms its privileges. Witnesses: Baldwin, archbishop of Trier, imperial archchancellor in Gaul, Engelbert, bishop of Liège; Rudolf and Rupert, counts palatine of the Rhine, the dukes John of Brabant, Henry his son, Henry of Glogau, Wladislaus of Teschen, William, margrave of Jülich; the abbots Richard of St. Cornelius-Inden, and Hugo of Stablo; the counts John of Spanheim, William of Wied and William of Katzenellenbogen; the nobles John, lord of Falkenberg, John of Falkenberg, lord of Burn, Reinold of Randinrode, Jodok of Rosenberg, Bernhard of Czimburg, his steward, Sbinco of Hasenburg and Busco of Wilhartitz, his chamberlains, Arnold of Bolant and Henry of Huffalitz. I Nicol, royal chancellor, prelate of Prague, in the place and name of Baldwin, archbishop of Trier, imperial archchancellor in Gaul, received [this]. Quix Aachen 2,240-244. Loersch Achener Rechtsdenkmäler 58-66.
